{{Quote|Are we going home?''"<br />"''Yes.''"<br />"''And my daddy? Will he be okay?|Ferrouz's daughter and Mara Jade|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Ferrouz's daughter''' was the daughter of [[Bidor Ferrouz]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], and his [[Ferrouz's wife|wife]]. She was six-[[Standard year/Legends|years]]-old as of eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Alien/Legends|Alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] kidnapped Ferrouz's wife and daughter in a plot to force the governor to commit [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Empire, but both hostages were eventually rescued by the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].
